rubric_notes: Complete: a.22.1/47113, a.22/47112, a/46456; families 47114, 47129, 47134 (TAF(II)18/28/42/62, hTAF4/12, NF-YB/C, NC2, CHRAC, SOS all in bundle), 101318 with duplication annotation; fold core comment supported; superfamily supplies ancestry inference, fold/class do not; linker histone a.4.5.13/46827 separation with non-proof-of-independence caveat; function/template transfer rejected with explicit note that no representative was ranked. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.

Family SUNIDs 116993/140797 and superfamily 101386 verified against bundle; structural-genomics-target comment supported by d1vmga_ annotations. Correctly frames superfamily as homology-bearing level, family split as limit, and rejects transfer of HisE substrate/pathway and MazG roles; lists needed external evidence. Complete.

Correct families with SUNIDs under c.55.1 (53067), fold c.55, class c; all supported by bundle. Correctly notes actin/HSP70 share a family. Duplication comment supported by annotations endpoint. Infers probable common ancestry stronger than fold/class, states it does not establish the ancestral reaction, and rejects transfer of polymerization, chaperone activity, substrate specificity, reaction chemistry, regulation, and templates. Names required external evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.

Correct family/superfamily/fold/class identifiers for release 2.08; fold core and bimetal-ion centre annotations and the RNR-like family's desaturase/monooxygenase members are all supported by the cited annotations and children endpoints. States superfamily supplies the homology inference while fold/class alone give only structural similarity; interprets group as ancestral framework diversified for different chemistry. Rejects transfer of iron storage, radical generation, catalase activity, metal identity, mechanism, and template use; specifies alignments, residue conservation, metal-bound structures/spectroscopy, assays, assembly context, and states no alignment or literature was inspected. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All identifiers correct including class SUNID 48724 and fold comment (7 strands, 2 sheets, greek-key, additional strands variation), all in bundle. Superfamily-level homology vs fold/class similarity clearly stated. Correctly contrasts 'contains copper-binding site' with family 'lacking the metal-binding site' annotations. Requires conserved coordinating residues, ligand-bound/spectroscopic evidence, metal-binding biochemistry, redox measurements; notes hierarchy provides no alignments. PAD4 domain caveat. No violations.

Names d.15.1.1/d.15.1.2/d.15.1.5 with correct SUNIDs (54237/54250/54263) under superfamily d.15.1 (54236), fold d.15, class a+b, release 2.08; all consistent with evidence bundle. Correctly distinguishes superfamily-level homology from fold/class similarity. Explicitly rejects transfer of conjugation, degradation tagging, Ras binding, and p97/VCP binding across families, notes ubiquitin-related family does not guarantee conjugation, and lists required external evidence. No material omissions. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct families c.23.1.1 (52173), c.23.1.4 (52252), c.23.1.5 (82344) under c.23.1 (52172), fold c.23; parents endpoints in bundle confirm lineage. Superfamily-level homology vs fold similarity stated clearly. Rejects phosphoacceptor chemistry, phosphotransfer partners, chemotaxis, DNA binding, decarboxylation/cofactor binding, and circadian role; distinguishes isolated wing from whole enzyme and N-terminal KaiA domain from whole-protein KaiC regulation. KaiA annotation cited is supported by bundle. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct placement b.84.5.1 (310616) / b.84.5 (310577) / b.84 (51229) / class b, example domain d3a5ca3 3a5c A:113-184 matches bundle, four sibling superfamilies named, fold comment and PMID 19893485 supported by annotations endpoints. Clearly separates fold-level architecture from superfamily-level ancestry, states SCOPe makes no ancestry claim to b.84.1-b.84.4, rejects independent-origin inference, distinguishes family from superfamily, and states what the records cannot show. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All identifiers and hierarchy correct (f.21.1 81342, f.21.2 81343, f.21.3 103501, fold 81344, class f). Correctly separates fold-level similarity from superfamily homology, states that separate superfamilies do not prove convergence, reports the f.21.1/f.21.2 comments and the f.21.3 possible-link annotation without merging, and names sequence/profile, structural alignment with ligand positions, complex context and phylogenetic evidence. Bundle supports every claim. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Correct family, superfamily, fold, class identifiers with SUNIDs, all supported by bundle. Superfamily as evolutionary inference, fold/class only structural. Explicitly rejects ADH, CoA, channel-regulation transfer and name-based ligand inference; domain vs whole-protein; family annotation comment correctly cited; states hierarchy does not establish ancestral function or direction of divergence; lists required evidence. No material issues.

Family k.40.1.1 (SUNID 100905) with the 'not a true family' comment, full hierarchy and Synthetic species entries all supported by the bundle; states the level-based flag does not resolve the caveat; concludes shared designed classification with homology unresolved, not proven nonhomology; rejects amyloidogenicity/ligand/template transfer. No unmet criteria. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Complete. Correct 1.69 and 2.08 hierarchies; d1t1ja1 as current SID with retained SUNID supported by 2.08 parents call; shared superfamily c.23.14 with distinct families c.23.14.2/c.23.14.1. Strand-count contrast (4 vs 5, 'lacks the last strand') and superfamily comment supported by bundle annotations. Interprets change as SCOPe now supporting probable common ancestry while keeping family distinction. Rejects activity/substrate/template transfer. Minor note: periodic update label 2.08-2026-08-16 is correct but no /releases/current call appears in the bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.

Complete: tag H:1-8 SUNID 343393 in class l l.1.1.1 Tags; d1a14h1 H:9-111 VH b.1.1.1 hierarchy; explicit rejection of eight-residue tag matches as homology, function-transfer, or template evidence with shared-engineered-sequence explanation. Cites homology_implied_by_level=false and warning, both in bundle. States limits of fold/class similarity and antigen specificity. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct 1.75 whole-chain entry with its four-structural-domain fold comment and correct 2.08 pair, including SUNIDs, boundaries, PA14 and C-terminal-like classifications, the class b move, and the retained domains II-IV in the C-terminal unit. Reasoning is complete: homology can belong to a component rather than a chain, the revision is not a four-way split, different classifications do not prove independent origins, and a PA14 hit cannot be extended to the chain or used to transfer function, ligand specificity, or whole-protein template suitability. Claims verification of the split in 2.07 and 2.08 while the bundle holds only 2.08 release records, and it does not identify 2.04 as the first release, leaving the historical boundary change imprecise.

Mosaic of five domains stated; d3jb9a4 bromodomain a.29.2.1, d3jb9a3 RT e.8.1.8, d3jb9a2 endonuclease c.52.1.36, d3jb9a1 RNase H c.55.3.14 all correct; d3jb9a5 A:47-697 identified as new fold d.394; reuse vs innovation drawn; function-transfer and new-fold caveats stated. Annotation claims (Cwf17 helix, Cwf10 lasso, retroviral RT homology, linker domain) supported by bundle. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Directly answers the inference: homologous repeat architecture, not fixed length, with lengths 51/373/752 and all three in family a.298.1.1 under superfamily a.298.1, fold a.298, class a. Uses the 'single repeat' description, the 're' caveat on two domains, and the 34-residue representative repeat 4cj9 A:259-292 with correct coordinate-scope limits. Explicitly denies equal repeat counts, equal coverage, identical DNA specificity, and representative-as-quality-winner. Evidence matches the bundle throughout.

Metadata correct and bundle-supported (2.08, 2.08-stable, dates, 2.08-2026-08-16). Advises citing 2.08-stable, pinning to 2.08, and preserving the full dated label when using the update; avoids the moving current alias. Does not treat the update as a new stable release. Omits the required statement that periodic updates add newly classified PDB entries without rewriting older stable-release domains, instead declining to characterize the update's contents. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete: correct family/superfamily/fold/class with all SIDs, quotes fragment comment and ms flag, cites four-long-helix fold description, says truncated three-helix resemblance must be read in context of the complete architecture, warns against extrapolating fragments to full-domain templates. Also checks 1.55 records (supported by bundle) and honestly notes they do not date a reassignment. Caveats on STAT/spectrin homology and function are correct. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Convergence vs divergence handled with explicit limit on SCOPe separation. Correct level semantics. Evidence integration includes sequence/profile, global structural alignment, motifs at equivalent positions, domain architecture, phylogeny, ligand-bound structures, biochemistry; notes those were not retrieved. Rejects function/template transfer. c.2.1 (51735, c.2) and c.31.1 (52467, c.31), class c, verified; the cited SCOPe comment that DHS-like domains bind cofactor in the opposite direction to the Rossmann fold is present in the 52467 annotations response.

Correct before and after placements with SUNIDs and the Cry3A boundary, correct statement that class b alone asserted neither homology nor independent origin, and correct superfamily-level ancestry with families retained. Marshals fold descriptions for both the old CUB-like and current b.18 folds, the calcium-state strand caveat, and the PubMed 17977833 comment, while stating plainly that the paper was not retrieved and that cluster-representative matches cannot stand in for a direct 1nqd-1dlc alignment. Refuses galactose, collagen, collagenase, insecticidal, and template transfer and limits the claim to the domains, not the full proteins.

All must_include met: family a.4.1.1 (46690) still supports homology; hf correctly defined as different fold from exemplar despite similar sequence and SSE count, explicitly not cancelling homology; helix packing, contacts, binding-site geometry, templates declared non-interchangeable; datasets retain hf, stratify or exclude, keep relatives together in splits. Notes mutant/complex comments and that fold/class alone do not establish homology. SUNIDs 94286/125655/46690/46689 and release 2.08 match the evidence bundle. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Meets all must_include: homology retained via family b.1.2.1; fr defined as >1/3 missing with coverage-aware alignment and non-comparable scores; d1uc6a1 provisional complete representative, fragment retained with explicit label/region. Family-diversity stratification and no-function-transfer caveats present. Identifiers, boundaries, SUNIDs correct for 2.08. SPACI/AEROSPACI values and methods quoted are correct SCOPe values though the quality endpoint is not in this bundle; not treated as fabrication. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. All must_include items satisfied; correctly notes new superfamily and new family are nested rather than alternatives; family asserts probable ancestry with closer grouping; new superfamily does not establish convergence; new fold requires distinct topology and lack of homology alone insufficient; classification is a revisable hypothesis requiring profile, conserved-feature, functional and phylogenetic evidence. Rejects function/template transfer. No release-specific claims; no factual errors.

All three families with correct SCCS/SUNIDs, superfamily 56112, fold 56111, class d; fold comment (two alpha+beta domains, C-terminal mostly helical) is supported by the 56111 annotations entry in the bundle. Correctly states superfamily supports ancestry while fold/class give only similarity, and limits the conclusion to catalytic domains. Mechanistic framework described with clear limits on catalytic competence and nucleotide preference, and flagged as general knowledge rather than SCOPe data. Refuses transfer of Ser/Thr/Tyr preference, aminoglycoside identity/position, PI3K lipid preference, activation-loop, regulatory-subunit and membrane control. Evidence list complete (sequence/profile, structural alignment, specificity loops, ligand-bound structures, biochemistry, domain architecture, partners, localization, cellular studies, phylogeny). No errors.
